question_text:
(a)  Finance manager of A Ltd. noticed that a 5% increase in sales leads to
increase of ` 9,000 in operating profit. The company operates with a
contribution margin of 40%, fixed annual operating cost of `1,35,000 and
interest obligation of ` 30,000.
You are required to calculate:
(i)  Current level of sales of the company.
(ii)  Operating, financial and combined leverage.
(2 + 3 = 5 Marks)
